text:
What is the most effective method of demagnetising a bar magnet?
A
placing the magnet in a solenoid carrying a large alternating current and gradually
decreasing the current
B
placing the magnet in a solenoid carrying a large direct current and gradually decreasing the
current
C
placing the magnet in a solenoid that produces a magnetic field in the opposite direction to
the magnet
D
placing the magnet next to an identical bar magnet with its poles in the opposite direction
